arStrings.szText: Purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.

When you deal damage, you have a {c_number}[SF_20*100|%|]{/c} chance to grow a flower that reacts when stepped on. 

{icon:bullet} When activated by an enemy, it deals {c_random}{SF_4}{/c} Poisoning damage to {if:SF_2}surrounding enemies{else}them{/if} over {c_number}{SF_5}{/c} seconds. 
{icon:bullet} When activated by an ally, it Heals {if:SF_2}surrounding allies{else}them{/if} for {c_random}[SF_7*100|1|]%{/c} of their Maximum Life. 

A flower can only activate once and can only grow on a specific enemy every {c_number}[SF_8]{/c} seconds.
The flower now applies its effects in an area.
